overview: A token app for TTTI-T where users buy, hold, send and track a fixed-supply ICRC token, with its own built-in transaction index.
features: Buy TTTI-T with ICP through a guided setup flow
Built-in wallet and Plug wallet support
Full transaction history including older transactions
Token canister also serves as its own index for wallets like OISY
Amount fields accept both point and comma as decimal separator
Delivery address prefilled with the chosen wallet's address
Technical details with ledger and index canister IDs
